callouts.label: Title
callouts.hint: The single largest line of print, at the very top of the card.
callouts.description: A short, inviting project name, like 'Rainbow Chase' rather than 'LED Strip Loop Exercise.'

callouts.label: Materials List
callouts.hint: A short bulleted list in the upper-middle of the card.
callouts.description: Every physical or software tool needed, checked against actual kit inventory before the session.

callouts.label: Colored Border
callouts.hint: The solid coloured band running all the way around the card's outer edge.
callouts.description: Signals difficulty at a glance: green for a Beginner Card, blue for an Intermediate Card, black for an Advanced Card. This example shows a green Beginner Card.

callouts.label: Numbered Steps
callouts.hint: The largest block of print, filling the middle of the card.
callouts.description: Clear, sequential instructions written at the target track's reading level.

callouts.label: Stretch Goal
callouts.hint: A separate boxed area in the lower part of the card.
callouts.description: An optional extra challenge for a student who finishes early, preventing idle time.

callouts.label: Concept Tag
callouts.hint: A small rounded chip in the bottom corner of the card.
callouts.description: Names the computational thinking skill or syntax concept the card reinforces, tying back to the skill progression ladder from Chapter 14.
